Select activities.activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units. From activities. Join molecule_dictionary on activities via activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join assays on activities via activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays via assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Filter activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Filter activities.standard_type IN ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'). Filter activities.standard_value < 50. Sort activities.activity_id ASC. Limit 200.
